name: Wise Widget Manager – Classic Widgets & Sidebar Control
author: bisnusnr

sections.description:
Wise Widget Manager is the ultimate WordPress widget manager, giving you a centralized dashboard to control every sidebar and widget area in your classic WordPress theme.

If you are running the Classic Editor plugin to keep your writing workflow simple, you shouldn’t have to struggle with fragmented widget screens. Stop wasting time navigating multiple, disjointed admin interfaces. With Wise Widget Manager, you can view, preview, reorder, and optimize all your active widgets from one unified interface. It enhances the default WordPress widget architecture without overwriting it—so you get a faster, more visual workflow that fits seamlessly into your existing setup.

Built explicitly as the perfect companion for sites utilizing classic themes, the Classic Editor, and traditional widget screens, this plugin restores sanity to complex layouts, making sidebar management effortless.

A quick note on adding new widgets:
To add a brand-new widget to your site, simply use the native WordPress flow via Appearance → Widgets. Once added, it will instantly sync and appear inside your Wise Widget Manager dashboard, ready for quick organization and visibility tweaks.

Features

  • All-in-One Control Center – See and manage every active widget across every sidebar on a single, intuitive page. No more tab-hopping.

  • Effortless Drag & Drop Reordering – Rearrange your layout and widget priority instantly with smooth drag-and-drop functionality. No code required.

  • Safe Isolated Live Previews – Test widget modifications within a strict iframe preview before publishing. Ensure your changes look perfect without breaking your live site.

  • Instant Removal – Purge unwanted widgets from any sidebar area with a single click, keeping your widget management clean and clutter-free.

  • Device-Specific Visibility Rules – Dynamically show or hide widgets based on the user’s device type. Optimize experiences for Desktop, iPad/Tablet, and Mobile audiences.

  • Authentication & Login Rules – Control widget visibility by user status. Display widgets exclusively to logged-in members, hide them from visitors, or vice versa—perfect for membership sites.

  • Classic & Gutenberg Block Support – Manage legacy classic widgets and modern Gutenberg blocks side by side, all within the same seamless dashboard.

  • Search for Widgets – Quickly locate specific widgets across all your sidebars using our powerful built-in search filter. Never waste time hunting again.

  • Lightning-Fast Performance – Built on a lightweight architecture with optimized WordPress REST API calls, ensuring zero bloat and minimal impact on your site speed.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Navigate to Tools → Wise Widget Manager
  4. Start managing your widgets
sections.faq:
Does this replace the default WordPress widgets screen?

No. It enhances the default system by providing a centralized management dashboard.

Is it compatible with block widgets?

It is primarily designed for classic themes and classic widgets, but it safely bridges traditional sidebars into a modern visual dashboard.

Will it slow down my site?

No. The plugin is lightweight, assets are compiled for production, and it communicates via optimized REST API endpoints.
